rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects

scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a reasonable investigation and identified the core issue of a signing target operating on files from a shared output directory that it didn't build. The diagnosis of parallel file contention is partially correct but misses the more precise root cause of CAS hard links in CloudBuild creating read-only files that signtool cannot modify. The 84% failure rate is better explained by the hard-link mechanism than by transient lock contention. The suggested fixes are practical and mostly appropriate, though they don't address the underlying CAS/hard-link issue. The investigation was methodical and efficient, but the final diagnosis lacks the deeper insight about why 'Access is denied' specifically occurs.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied
